verdict.rationale: The evidence documents an OpenAI-compatible `/chat/completions` endpoint and provider switching. Nothing in the pack mentions JSON-schema structured outputs, `response_format`, or schema enforcement or normalization across providers. A unified gateway could plausibly offer this, so the axis applies, and the absence of evidence yields none. The JSON-based routing configuration is an unrelated feature and earns no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can request structured JSON-schema outputs across providers
